meta.title: Submitting a bid just before the bidding window closes processes successfully with loading factor

plan.title: Reject selected proposal bid is refused

steps.note: Open the prepared Responses tab for the closed RFQ whose Vendor A bid is selected in a pending proposal.
Attempt to reject Vendor A's selected bid from the buyer's Responses view.

args.text: Can not reject a bid which is selected for proposal

steps.note: Verify Procol refuses the rejection with the required R-BID-030-6 message.
Verify Vendor A's bid remains Active after the rejected action.
